description: This Java class 'AcknowledgementAdapter' maps Acknowledgement objects to and from Adaptable representations, handling topic path creation, header translation, and payload construction within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAdapter
classes.description: Final class implementing Adapter for mapping Acknowledgement objects to and from Adaptable representations, handling topic path creation, header translation, and payload construction.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of AcknowledgementAdapter with the provided HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Builds a TopicPathBuilder for a given channel and entity ID, setting the appropriate channel (twin or live).

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into an Acknowledgement, extracting label, thing ID, status code, headers, and payload.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Acknowledgement into an Adaptable object with appropriate topic path, payload, and headers.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set of TopicPath groups this adapter belongs to (THINGS).

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set of supported channels (TWIN, LIVE).

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria (ACKS) for topic matching.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set of actions.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates this adapter is used for responses (true).

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates that a subject is required in the topic path (true).

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Builds a TopicPath for the given acknowledgement and channel.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Constructs a Payload object from the acknowledgement's status and entity.

methods.name: getExternalHeaders
methods.description: Translates internal headers to external headers, adding content type if missing.
